checks: Only hardcoded initialize RPC; no general request/session/prompt API
Trusted launch configuration is pinned and cannot be supplied through runtime requests
Grant/policy/run/resource closure rechecked before and after async preparation, on publication and via background monitoring
Idempotent start/close reauthorize and never restart an old instance
Read path performs no process/network action or database write; known transport faults override stale ready
Only owned live child handles are closed; restart loses ownership and reports unknown
Forced or unobserved exits never prove execution stop or release locks
No invented native session ID or capability qualification; declarations remain disabled
Raw provider payload/stderr excluded from projections; bounded local diagnostics and visible failure
Default test commands never launch official DSH
Original user changes and protected source/package boundaries verified
